headline_stat.name: fraction of excitatory CA1 units classified as place cells (per session)

stated_limitation: consistent with very sparsely-firing pyramidal cells not producing enough spikes during a single session to reach significance, rather than with place cells per se being high-rate

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsaki CA1 linear-track) is the canonical place-cell dataset, and four sessions from four rats are used.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile, with the mislabeled rate/period quirk caught and corrected and a PCA linearization validated (r=-1.000) against the sparse provided channel.
justification.analysis: Skaggs spatial information with a proper per-cell circular-shift shuffle null and a 0.2 Hz rate floor is the standard, correct method with the required control present.
justification.correctness: Numbers are internally consistent with the figures (68 units = 40 place + 28 non-place; 48 exc + 20 inh), but the hash-based per-session seed is non-deterministic and a few near-zero-SI cells are labeled place cells without comment.
justification.figures: Figures clearly show the effect: the sorted heatmap tiles the full 1.6 m track, examples are ranked by spatial information (the effect metric), and axes carry units and sample sizes.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and it flags the data quirk and the firing-rate confound, but there is no dedicated discussion of the liberal classification or the low-SI cells passing the criterion.
